Total Assets
As of 30 September 2025, total assets  was 3,924.6 million, increased by 501.6  million or +14.7% 
compared to 31 December 2024, with the key changes as follows:
•Cash and Cash Equivalents: Increased by 113.4 million, primarily due to the exercise of TGE -
Warrant 1, net of loan repayments, and construction payments for CPN and RBR WTE power 
plants.
•Property, Plant, and Equipment: Increased by 128.1 million, mainly from the net effect of ( i) 
ongoing construction of the RBR WTE power plant, asset acquisitions in the biomass power 
plants, and (ii) depreciation expenses for the period.
•Rights from service concession arrangements : Increased by 196.7 million, driven by 
construction activities at the CPN WTE power plants.Total Liabilities
As of 30 September  2025, total liabilities was 864.0 million, increased by 18.6 million or 2.2% compared to 31 
December 2024, with key changes as follows:
•Construction payables: Increased by 192.8  million due to the construction of CPN and RBR WTE power 
plants
•Loans from Financial Institutions : Decreased by 173.8 million from loan repayments 
As of 30 September   2025, the D/E ratio was 0.28, down from 0.33 as of 31 December 2024, and IBD/E ratio 
was 0.14, down from 0.23 as of 31 December 2024. It was primarily driven by loan repayments and the 
increased equity from the exercise of TGE -Warrant 1 and net profit generated during the period.
Total Shareholders’ Equity
As of 30 September  2025, total shareholders’ equity was 3,060.7  million, increased by 483.0 million or
